immutable_ground_truth.statement: Batch b-7103 was retried at 2026-06-11T23:47:52Z and later failed at 2026-06-12T00:03:05Z, both with duplicate_payment_warning error and 18401 invoice rows.
Batches b-7104, b-7105, b-7106 all failed with downstream_console_index_missing error and durations of 900 seconds.
Batches b-7108 and b-7109 succeeded with no error code, durations of 344 and 352 seconds respectively.
All failed or retried batches had duration_seconds of 900.
The first failed/retry rows begin after CHG-142 enabled a batching flag.
Failed rows continue until shortly after a rollback timestamp referenced in change_and_staffing_notes.md.
This data is synthetic and used for a public demo.

source_summary: Synthetic export-worker logs showing a sequence of billing export batch statuses from June 11-15, 2026. Contains multiple failures and retries between June 12-13, with error codes duplicate_payment_warning and downstream_console_index_missing. Some later batches succeeded. The source does not prove root cause but shows a failure pattern temporally linked to a batching flag and rollback timeframe from another document.
